laboratory accreditation, centralisation and a research setting improve the quality of molecular biomarker testing.
laboratory accreditation, a centralised setting and a research environment are associated with fewer analysis failures and technical failures in oncology biomarkers testing.

the quality of biomarker testing in pathology laboratories, the impact of laboratory characteristics and the importance of accreditation in this field.
improving patient safety by assuring quality in biomarker testing laboratories.
the development of a quality assurance framework for biomarker testing in oncology.

accreditation is the most relevant indicator to assure quality in molecular pathology laboratories.

the laboratory setting, number analysed, and detection method are not the most important factors in achieving high quality in biomarker testing.
